evidence_spans: first_confirming_probe: GET /render.php?target=http://127.0.0.1:5000/status&target=https://example.com the PDF contains 'depotprint render worker online'

all_of: a gateway builds an upstream URL by concatenating the raw query string
the gateway validator and the internal worker read the same duplicated parameter with different parser semantics
a report formatter calls .format on a row that stores attacker text
any_of: an internal chrome/worker that renders and stores the fetched page
a manifest endpoint protected by a locally signed JWT

chain.action: place the internal URL as the FIRST target and a clean external URL as the LAST duplicate: ?target=http://127.0.0.1:5000/status&target=https://example.com
chain.why: PHP reads the last occurrence for the gate; Werkzeug's args.get returns the first, so the worker chrome fetches the loopback URL

chain.action: render the internal /queue route through the same trick and read the spool report the snapshot PDF prints
chain.why: the /queue page is loopback-only but runs spool_line, whose .format substitutes placeholders that reached the stored row

chain.action: store a braced target containing {spool_line.__globals__[app].config[SIGNING_KEY]} first, then render /queue as the second job so the format-string substitution lands inside the next snapshot
chain.why: format supports attribute access and string-key lookup without quotes, and a callable in the namespace becomes a read primitive

chain.action: forge a supervisor:true HS256 ticket with the leaked signing key and render /console?ticket=<JWT> through the same dup-key trick
chain.why: the manifest table holds the seeded flag row and console is supervisor-only

first_confirming_probe.request: GET /render.php?target=http://127.0.0.1:5000/status&target=https://example.com&label=D&note=x and read the produced PDF
first_confirming_probe.expected: the PDF contains the text 'depotprint render worker online'
first_confirming_probe.falsifier: both targets are rejected, or the PDF shows the external page only

blast_radius: arbitrary request forgery through a behind-the-gate chrome; the leaked signing key impersonates supervisors until the container restarts

verification.evidence: manifest depot-master-record note read from the rendered /console PDF on 192.168.223.1:9000
verification.proof: the depot-master-record manifest note (the flag) read from a rendered /console PDF

reuse_when: a reverse-proxy or gateway quotes the same parameter twice through two stacks
a report renderer formats user text with a callable in its format namespace
a loopback-only JSON API is protected by a JWT signed with a key stored in app.config
known_traps: the raw QUERY_STRING forwarding means percent-encoded bytes reach the worker unchanged; werkzeug decodes them once
a stored {format} payload only explodes the NEXT time /queue is rendered, not at insert time
Chrome percent-encodes braces in the displayed URL; the same_document comparison survives via unquote
httpbin-style redirect chains die against same_document; the parser split does not need a redirector
the PDF text layer is glyph-IDs mapped by ToUnicode; decode bfchar and bfrange or the text reads as garbage
